decision.explanation: Different from every known condition. C04 is numerically nearest (7.62 dB), narrowly ahead of C03 (7.82 dB), but neither is a supported match: both query distances greatly exceed the 3.04 dB C03–C04 reference separation, while C02 is still farther at 10.60 dB.
